review.workflow.preview.title: Previewing the producer experience
review.workflow.preview.body: This is the frozen version the producer sees. Review controls are disabled in staff preview.
review.workflow.complete.title: Episode approved
review.workflow.complete.body: The producer review is complete. This approved snapshot is final.
review.workflow.decide.title: Decide {n} remaining scene(s)
review.workflow.decide.body: Approve the current scene, or request changes and explain exactly what Pulsar should fix.
review.workflow.waiting.title: Changes requested in {n} scene(s)
review.workflow.waiting.body: Your requests were sent. Pulsar must create and submit a revised version before you can finish this review.
review.workflow.final.title: All scenes approved — final approval needed
review.workflow.final.body: Approve the episode to finish the review. This is a separate final action and does not happen automatically.
review.workflow.approver.title: All scenes approved — waiting for an approver
review.workflow.approver.body: Your scene review is complete. A producer approver must give the final episode approval.
review.decision.approvedBody: This decision was saved. You can change it while the review remains open.
review.decision.pendingBody: No decision has been saved for this scene yet.
review.request.placeholder: Be specific about meaning, tone, character voice, or wording…
review.request.help: Your note is sent to Pulsar with this scene and becomes their next action.
review.request.reasonRequired: Add a reason so Pulsar knows what to change.
review.saved.approved: Scene {n} approved. Your decision was saved.
review.saved.alternative: Changes requested for scene {n}. Pulsar has been notified.
review.saveFailed: Could not save the scene decision.
review.finalReady: Every scene is approved. This final action completes the producer review.
review.episodeBlocked.changes: Cannot approve yet: Pulsar must revise {n} scene(s).
review.episodeBlocked.remaining: Cannot approve yet: decide the remaining {n} scene(s).
review.previewDisabled: Staff preview — producer decision controls are disabled.
wb.submit.lines: {n} of {total} lines are ready. Finish every English line before sending this episode.
wb.scene.notReady: {n} line(s) in this scene still need a complete English adaptation.
wb.workflow.start.title: Generate the first English draft
wb.workflow.start.body: Start the AI pass, then review every English line before marking scenes ready.
wb.workflow.blocked.title: English drafting is blocked
wb.workflow.blocked.body: AI is not configured on this server. Ask an administrator to connect the Anthropic API before this episode can move forward.
wb.workflow.edit.title: Finish the English adaptation
wb.workflow.edit.body: {n} line(s) still need complete English text, rationale, or back-translation. Select each highlighted line and finish it.
wb.workflow.readyScenes.title: Review and mark scenes ready
wb.workflow.readyScenes.body: All lines are complete. Review the bilingual result, then mark the remaining {n} scene(s) ready for the producer.
wb.workflow.send.title: Ready to send to the producer
wb.workflow.send.body: Every line and scene is ready. Send this version to freeze it and begin producer review.
wb.workflow.waiting.title: Waiting for producer review
wb.workflow.waiting.body: The submitted snapshot is read-only. No staff action is needed until the producer decides or requests an alternative.
wb.workflow.returned.title: Producer requested changes in {n} scene(s)
wb.workflow.returned.body: Read the producer notes below, create a revision, address each request, and send the new version back.
wb.workflow.approved.title: Producer approved this episode
wb.workflow.approved.body: The approved snapshot is final and ready to export. Create a revision only if a new change is required.
wb.workflow.manual.title: Start a manual English draft
wb.workflow.manual.body: AI is not configured, but you can still continue. Create editable blank lines, then translate each one before marking scenes ready.
admin.episodeNext.start: Create an English draft for {n} line(s)
wb.fork.reviewPending: Wait for the producer to decide the remaining {n} scene(s) before creating a revision.
wb.workflow.feedbackPending.title: Producer feedback received — review still in progress
wb.workflow.feedbackPending.body: The request is visible below. Wait for the producer to decide the remaining {n} scene(s), then create one revision that addresses all feedback.
wb.requests.label: Producer feedback
wb.requests.title: {n} timestamped change request(s)
wb.requests.frozenHelp: The request and exact note are shown below. Create a revision to edit the submitted version.
wb.requests.pendingHelp: The request and exact note are shown below. The producer still has {n} scene(s) to decide; revision editing unlocks when their review is complete.
wb.requests.draftHelp: You are editing the revision. Resolve each note below, mark the scene ready again, then send the new version to the producer.
admin.episodeNext.feedbackPending: {changes} change request received · producer has {remaining} scene(s) left
wb.adapted.manualHint: Use Start manual draft above to create editable English lines without AI.
reviewStudio.workflow.body: Review the script in time order. Click any timestamp to comment on that exact line, or approve the scene when it is ready.
reviewStudio.clickTimestamp: Click a timestamp to jump to a line and edit it on the right
reviewStudio.revisionThreadHelp: Review the complete change history before approving.
reviewStudio.responsePending: Pulsar has not explained how this request was handled.
reviewStudio.selectedMomentHelp: The request will be pinned to this exact line and timestamp.
reviewStudio.commentPlaceholder: Describe exactly what should change at this moment…
reviewStudio.saved.request: Change request sent at {time}. Pulsar will see it on the same line.
wb.submit.responses: Respond to {n} producer request(s) before sending the revision.
wb.requests.responsePlaceholder: Explain how the revised line follows the request, or why a different solution works better…
reviewStudio.sceneApprovedHelp: Nothing is locked until final episode approval. Select any timestamp if you notice a specific issue.
pw.home.title: My titles
pw.home.sub: Localize subtitles, refine the English adaptation, and deliver timed files.
pw.new.title: New title
pw.new.sub: Fill in the title's info and upload each episode's script or subtitle file.
pw.new.notesHint: Main characters' names, roles and relationships; the adaptation uses this.

pw.upload.hint: SRT / VTT / ASS subtitle files or a TXT script; one file per episode.
pw.steps.label: Workflow
pw.title.noEpisodes: No episodes yet — upload a script first.
pw.ep.sub: Original on top, adaptation below; every change explains itself.
pw.gen.title: Generate the U.S. adaptation
pw.gen.body: The AI rewrites each line in natural American English — not a translation, but a rewrite of rhythm and tone for U.S. viewers. Every change carries a Chinese explanation, and you can edit any line afterwards.
pw.gen.unmatched: {n} line(s) have no pre-authored translation (demo mode covers the bundled scripts only).
pw.gen.step3: Adapting each line for U.S. viewers
pw.line.pending: This line has not been adapted yet.
pw.alts.none: No more alternatives for this line.
pw.finalize.confirm: Finalizing freezes this episode with a hash; further edits need a new revision.
pw.final.banner: This episode is finalized and archived
pw.export.hint: Export the finalized files any time
pw.review.banner: Pulsar submitted this version. Finalize it as is, or edit it yourself first.
pw.alts.suggested: Suggested alternatives — tap to use one
pw.panel.title: Review & edit
pw.cmd.confirm.title: {n} scene(s) left to confirm
pw.cmd.confirm.body: Click any timestamp to review a line — edit it directly or take an alternative; confirm each scene, then finalize.
pw.cmd.ready.title: Ready to finalize
pw.cmd.ready.body: Every scene is confirmed. Finalizing freezes and archives this episode; export any time.
pw.cmd.review.title: Pulsar submitted this version
pw.cmd.review.body: Finalize it as is, or edit it yourself first.
pw.cmd.done.title: This episode is finalized
pw.cmd.done.body: Content is frozen and archived; export the finalized files on the right.
pw.confirm.done: Updated — the script on the left reflects it.
pw.confirm.hint: Edit the line or pick an alternative, then Save line to apply.
pw.confirm.clean: Edit the English above, or view the alternatives.
pw.cmd2.lines.title: {n} line(s) left to adapt
pw.cmd2.lines.body: Click any timestamp — edit the English directly or take an alternative. Finalize once every line is ready.
pw.cmd2.ready.body: Every line is adapted. Finalize to export the English script and the subtitled video.
pw.cmd2.done.body: Frozen and archived. Download the English script and the subtitled video from the rail.
pw.subvid.done: Subtitled video ready ({n} cues) — opened in a new tab.
pw.upload.hint2: One row per episode: set the number, pick that episode's subtitle/script file; video optional.
qc.title: Delivery preflight
pw.upload.hint3: Upload video, subtitles/script, or both for each episode. Promote can start from video; Adapt can add text later. Files sort into episodes by filename.
pw.upload.pick: Drop all your files here, or click to choose
pw.upload.pickHint: Subtitles and videos together — matched to episodes by filename (ep1.srt, ep1.mp4 …)
pw.slots.missingSub: This episode still needs its subtitle file
pw.gen.nomatch: This script isn't in the demo bank, so demo mode can't adapt it. Ask Pulsar to enable AI adaptation for your workspace.
pw.gen.overrun: taking longer than estimated — still generating…
st.notFinal.title: Finalize the script first, then style the subtitles
st.notFinal.body: Subtitles are built from the frozen, finalized script so later edits can't drift into the delivered video. Finish reviewing and finalize in the episode studio, and this page unlocks.
st.untimed.title: This episode has no timecodes
st.untimed.body: Subtitles need a start and end time for every line. This episode came from a plain-text script (or has no usable lines), so cues can't be generated — episodes ingested from SRT/VTT/ASS files support subtitles. The English script report is still available.
st.noVideo: No video attached — previewing style only
st.render.noVideo: No video on this episode yet — attach one in the episode studio to render the burned video here. The SRT/VTT files below work regardless.
st.retime.body: Each line here starts with an [hh:mm:ss] stamp — an earlier ingest left the timecodes inside the text. One click lifts them into a real timeline (end times from the following line) and, if this episode was finalized, refinalizes it automatically.
st.retime.review: Timeline repaired, but QC found issues to address — review in the episode studio, then finalize again.
st.t.offsetHint: Negative shifts every subtitle earlier (use negative when the audio runs ahead of the subs). Applied once, immediately.
st.t.pickCue: Click a line in the cue sheet below first - then adjust when it appears and disappears here.
st.t.keys: Keys: , and . nudge the selected cue by 100 ms; hold Shift for 500 ms.
st.t.warn.overlap: Cue {n} overlaps the previous by {v} ms
st.t.warn.beyond_video: Cue {n} runs {v} ms past the video
st.t.autosyncOff: Not available yet — contact Pulsar to enable auto-sync for your workspace.
v3.nav.title: Title workspace
v3.revise.help: The approved version stays archived. Your edits continue in a new version.
v3.subtitle.timingHint: Adjust cue timing and resolve timeline issues
v3.subtitle.deliveryHint: Preview subtitle styling and export final files
v3.title.actionHint: Each episode shows its next action
v3.title.addEpisodesHint: Upload new subtitle or video files
v3.done.body: The script is finalized. Create a new draft to revise it, or continue in Timing & delivery above.
pw.alts.picked: Alternative applied - press the save button below to confirm.
qc.fix.none: Fix with AI - nothing to fix right now
st.acc.timing.sub: Subtitles early or late? Line them up here
st.acc.deliver.sub: The subtitled video and the files
st.suggest.body: The subtitles look uniformly late: the timestamps are rounded to whole seconds (a frame-sampling artifact). Recommended: shift everything 0.5s earlier.
st.t.cue.tip: Click a line in the cue sheet below, then adjust exactly when it appears and disappears here.
st.t.setStart.tip: Make this line appear at the player's current moment
st.t.setEnd.tip: Make this line disappear at the player's current moment
st.t.offset.tip: Shift every subtitle earlier or later together
st.t.loop.tip: Replay the selected line on repeat
st.t.before.tip: Play from 2s before the selected line to hear the entry
st.merge.hint: Two short neighboring cues display together as two rows - on screen longer, less flicker. English-only content.
pw.alts.dir.title: Neither one? Take it another direction
pw.cmd.blocked.title: {n} issue(s) to fix before finalizing
pw.cmd.blocked.body: Preflight found blocking issues. Use Fix or Fix all with AI in the panel, then finalize.
promote.home.title: Promote
promote.home.sub: Turn your drama into ads, approve the strongest ideas, and follow them through launch.
promote.home.emptyTitle: Your first campaign starts with a drama
promote.home.emptyHint: Choose an uploaded title. Pulsar will turn its strongest moments into direct clips and creator-style ad concepts.
promote.new.title: What should these ads accomplish?
promote.new.sub: Give the creative team boundaries, not a shot list. We will bring back distinct hypotheses to review.
promote.new.noTitlesHint: Promote and Adapt use the same title library.
promote.new.videoRequired: This title needs at least one episode video before creative generation can begin.
promote.new.destination: Where viewers should go (optional for now)
promote.new.direction: What should viewers feel or understand?
promote.new.directionHint: For example: she looks powerless at first, but the audience should sense she is in control.
promote.new.exclusionsHint: Characters, episodes, plot reveals, claims, or visual moments to avoid.
promote.new.spoilerHint: This controls which moments can become hooks—not just the copy.
promote.new.outputHint: 5 concepts per round across direct drama clips and creator-style frames, each with hook, caption, description, and source timecode. We test 5 at a time; more rounds follow as results come in.
promote.workspace.sub: Review the hypothesis behind each ad—not just whether the clip looks good.
promote.workspace.readyHint: We will build five distinct concepts from the uploaded episode videos — one testable round. Launches continue beyond this round: we test five concepts at a time and add more as results come in.
promote.workspace.caption: Post caption
v3.dramaLibrary.sub: Every title you have in contact with Pulsar. Connect with Stage, our streaming platform, to see how they perform.
v3.dramaLibrary.emptyHint: Once connected with Stage, this page lists your titles with us and their viewing metrics.
promote.new.pickHint: The promotion is generated from this drama's episodes.
admin.promote.title: Promote desk
admin.promote.sub: Every producer campaign, what it needs from Pulsar, and where Grow has taken it.
admin.promote.empty: No campaigns yet. They appear here the moment a producer starts a promotion.
admin.promote.launch.submitted: The producer approved {n} creatives and submitted for launch. Create the Grow campaign, then record its progress here.
admin.promote.launch.launching: Launching on Grow. Confirm here once TikTok approves the ads.
admin.promote.launch.live: Live on TikTok. Metrics arrive with the Grow read-back.
admin.promote.launch.failed: Launch failed. Fix the campaign in Grow and retry.
admin.promote.launch.waiting: Nothing to launch yet — the producer has not submitted this campaign.
admin.promote.creatives.sub: Answer each change request with a revised version; the producer sees it as a fresh concept to keep or change again.
admin.promote.revise.caption: Caption
admin.promote.revise.closed: Review is closed for this campaign; revisions need a new round.
promote.workspace.roundNote: Round 1 · we test 5 concepts at a time and keep launching new rounds
promote.workspace.changeSent: Pulsar is working on this change
pw.cmd.explain.title: {n} line(s) missing their adaptation notes
pw.cmd.explain.body: These AI rewrites lack their Chinese rationale or back-translation, so finalize is held. Open each line and pick an alternative or edit it once by hand.
pw.err.aiOff: AI rewriting is not available in demo mode. Contact Pulsar to enable AI adaptation for your workspace.
